Name: Artisanal Soda Makers - Flower Pack Continued
Author: Shads4242
Description:
[center][size=5][b]About
[/b]﻿[/size][/center][size=2]Artisanal Soda Makers - Flower Pack Continued is a rewrite of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5258](PFM) Flower Pack for Artisanal Soda Makers[/url] by Fwippy and Hadi. This is compatible with the 1.6 version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5173]Artisanal Soda Makers[/url] that launched a few days ago. Whether you've gone hog wild with adding tons of new floral crops to your game or are sticking purely with the vanilla flowers, this mod's got you covered for all your flowery soda making needs! 

﻿[b]To Install[/b]: 
1) Ensure you have the most recent versions of Content Patcher, Extra Machine Config, and Artisanal Soda Makers installed
2) Download this mod from Nexus
[/size]3) Unzip the mod into your Mods folder
Changes from the Original

[list]
[*][size=2]Blue Rose Syrup/Soda/Cream Soda has been renamed Winter Rose Syrup/Soda/Cream Soda. The first of those items is now made with the Winter Rose from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url][/size]
[*]Clover Soda is now made with the Lucky Four Leaf Clover from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]
[*]Products for the Ancient Flower, Black Magic Viola, Nasturtium, Passion Flower, and Queen of the Night Tulip have been removed. They may be restored in future updates as the mods that those respective flowers are from are ported to 1.6 
[/list][center][/center][center][size=5][b]﻿FAQ

[/b][/size][/center][b]1: I have a bug and need help, what do I do?
[/b]A: Open a bug report. Please remember to provide a SMAPI log with your bug report, otherwise I'm not able to investigate the issue on my end. You also need to include what version of the mod you are using (manual configuration vs automatic configuration). Additionally, if you're using the manually configured version, you need to include what configuration settings you currently have enabled 

[b]2: Does this mod support making sodas with flowers from [insert mod name here]?
[/b]A: It should, provided the object in that mod is defined as belonging to the "flowers" category. The default products of "Flower-Flavored Sparkling Water" and "Flower Syrup" are coded to accept any flower as an input. Flower Syrup is then used to make Flower Soda and Flower Cream Soda 

[b]3: [insert mod name] has a rose item, but the soda it's producing isn't filling in the Rose Soda spot on my collections tab. What gives?
[/b]A: Currently this mod only natively supports base Stardew, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url], and the clover from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] for making the named sodas, with plans to add compatibility for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049?tab=description]Wildflour[/url]'s mods in version 1.1. 

[b]4: Can you write a compatibility patch for [insert mod name here]?
[/b]A: You can certainly request one. It has to be a mod that uses content patcher though - I don't really want to mess around with JSON Asset mods since that framework is deprecated

[b]5: The original mod was eventually planning on doing floral colas. Are you going to implement those? 
[/b]A: I don't know. I have a fairly large lists of mods I'm working on at the moment, so if I do add the floral colas it might be a while. Ideally I would love to say yes right off the bat, but I don't want to promise something I can't deliver on for a while.
